browser.name: anti.browser.tabs.list
browser.description: List tabs in the live AntiFan Desktop Browser GUI (every tab in the window by default; pass all: false to list only the tabs this session owns). Primary browser tool for theme development and live tab management.

all.description: List every tab in the browser window (default). Pass false to restrict the list to the tabs this session owns.

browser.name: anti.browser.tabs.create
browser.description: Open a new tab in live AntiFan Desktop Browser GUI without stealing focus by default.

browser.name: anti.browser.tabs.activate
browser.description: Switch the active tab visible to the user in live AntiFan Desktop Browser GUI by tabId.

browser.name: anti.browser.tabs.close
browser.description: Close a tab in live AntiFan Desktop Browser GUI by tabId.

browser.name: anti.browser.rebind_target
browser.description: Rebind this session attachment to a live tabId after the bound tab detached or died. Use tabs.list to find a live tab, then rebind; subsequent calls target that tab.

browser.name: anti.browser.set_automation_target
browser.description: Set the primary automation target tab for this session (authority rotation via CAS).

browser.name: anti.browser.navigate
browser.description: Navigate active or background tab in live AntiFan Desktop Browser GUI.

browser.name: anti.browser.reload
browser.description: Reload active or background tab in live AntiFan Desktop Browser GUI.

browser.name: anti.browser.set_viewport
browser.description: Set the bound tab viewport dimensions and device emulation, verified against the size the tab actually measures.

browser.name: anti.browser.get_viewport
browser.description: Get the bound tab viewport dimensions, DPR, device preset, and layout surface state without applying overrides.

browser.name: anti.browser.evaluate
browser.description: Execute JavaScript expression in page context with depth-capped circular protection. Refuses a tab with no laid-out surface (0x0 CSS px) unless allowDegradedSurface is set.

expressionFile.description: Workspace-relative path to a file containing the JavaScript expression; mutually exclusive with expression

allowDegradedSurface.description: Run even when the tab reports a 0x0 surface (diagnostic escape hatch; the page is not laid out and most measurements will be meaningless)

browser.name: anti.browser.evaluate_frame
browser.description: Execute JavaScript inside a child frame selected by frameUrl substring.

expressionFile.description: Workspace-relative path to a file containing the JavaScript expression; mutually exclusive with expression

browser.name: browser.set-viewport
browser.description: Set the bound Chromium tab viewport dimensions and device emulation.

browser.name: browser.get-viewport
browser.description: Get the bound Chromium tab viewport dimensions, DPR, device preset, and layout surface state without applying overrides.

browser.name: browser.wait
browser.description: Deterministic wait for selector, url, navigation, dom-stable, network, actionability, generation, or legacy condition states

condition.description: Wait condition to evaluate: selector | url | navigation | dom-stable | network | actionability | generation (or legacy aliases)

ref.description: Semantic reference token (@e1) to wait for

urlPattern.description: URL pattern or substring to match

minGeneration.description: Minimum document generation to wait for (generation or navigation condition)

idleWindowMs.description: Debounce idle window in milliseconds (500 default)

browser.name: anti.browser.dump_dom
browser.description: Stream clean or raw page DOM directly to a workspace file with zero MCP transport truncation and Windows-safe atomic writes.

inspect.name: anti.inspect.dom
inspect.description: Read DOM elements and computed attributes from AntiFan Desktop tab (supports desktop and mobile split panes). Operates directly against background tab.

inspect.name: anti.inspect.snapshot
inspect.description: Capture an accessible semantic snapshot of elements indexed with monotonic @e1..@eN references (supports selector and viewportOnly filtering).

inspect.name: anti.inspect.styles
inspect.description: Inspect computed CSS styles, box model, typography, layout, and CSS variables for an element (supports @ref or CSS selector).

inspect.name: anti.inspect.region
inspect.description: Inspect spatial region bounds, collecting intersecting visible DOM elements with coordinates and z-index.

inspect.name: anti.inspect.page_inventory
inspect.description: Scan entire physical page structure from y=0 to scrollHeight, returning list of all sections, coordinates, heights, and layout groups (chống sót header/footer/newsletter).

inspect.name: anti.inspect.style_diff
inspect.description: Compare computed CSS styles and box-model metrics between elements on two tabs (or two selectors).

selector.description: CSS selector of target element on tab 1

comparisonSelector.description: CSS selector on tab 2 (defaults to selector)

inspect.name: anti.inspect.matched_styles
inspect.description: Inspect live CDP matched CSS and classify active versus overridden declarations.

inspect.name: anti.inspect.responsive_matrix
inspect.description: Probe document and target overflow at the five standard responsive widths.

capture.name: anti.screenshot.viewport
capture.description: Capture high-fidelity viewport screenshot from live AntiFan Desktop GUI (supports desktop and mobile split panes, format: jpeg/png). Viewport-only: full_page:true is rejected; use anti.screenshot.full_page for entire document height.

capture.name: anti.screenshot.full_page
capture.description: Capture canonical PNG full-page evidence (entire document scroll height) and stage it under the evidence lease.

capture.name: anti.reference.capture
capture.description: Capture a reference from a live page: materialize lazily-mounted content, settle, then stage the settled DOM (and optionally a screenshot) so later measurements describe the page a comparator actually rasterizes.

capture.name: anti.visual.compare
capture.description: Compare current viewport or tab against baseline screenshot with pixel-level diffing, element selection, dynamic masking, and configurable tolerance.

fullPage.description: Capture and compare entire document scroll height

theme.name: theme.qa_validate
theme.description: Run the authoritative Theme QA verification workflow for the bound storefront tab and workspace.

theme.name: theme.debug_bundle
theme.description: Return an atomic storefront diagnostic bundle with platform, Liquid, overflow, and HS findings.

theme.name: theme.assert_cart
theme.description: Inspect passive storefront cart contract telemetry without adding synthetic items.

theme.name: theme.resolve_product
theme.description: Auto-resolve complete storefront product variant matrix, pricing, SKU, and availability.

theme.name: storefront.resolve_product
theme.description: Auto-resolve complete storefront product variant matrix, pricing, SKU, and availability.

theme.name: anti.theme.style_override
theme.description: In-memory ephemeral CSS stylesheet override for safe theme testing without writing files to disk (bypasses CLI watchers).

theme.name: theme.style_override
theme.description: In-memory ephemeral CSS stylesheet override for safe theme testing without writing files to disk (bypasses CLI watchers).

theme.name: anti.theme.resolve_element
theme.description: Map a live DOM element to bounded, correlated local theme source candidates.

theme.name: anti.theme.export_clean
theme.description: Materialize, sanitize (Livewire/SSR blobs and unhydrated modals stripped), and export clean static theme HTML directly to workspace file.

verification.name: anti.spec.validate_gate
verification.description: Validate HTML Specification against target page to certify HTML_SPEC_READY status before theme compilation.

verification.name: anti.verification.record_claim
verification.description: Record a live verification claim as UNVERIFIED with explicit proof obligations.

verification.name: anti.verification.verify_claim
verification.description: Evaluate a recorded claim against fresh live browser evidence and persist an authoritative receipt.

verification.name: anti.verification.list
verification.description: List recorded verification claims and their current verdicts.

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.cursor.click
agent_cursor.description: Move visual Agent Cursor and click an element in live AntiFan Desktop tab without stealing visual focus.

force.description: Skip the occlusion and animation-stability gates for a knowingly covered or endlessly animating target

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.cursor.move
agent_cursor.description: Move visible Agent Cursor without clicking in live AntiFan Desktop tab.

force.description: Skip the occlusion and animation-stability gates for a knowingly covered or endlessly animating target

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.cursor.type
agent_cursor.description: Move visual Agent Cursor and type into an input element in live AntiFan Desktop tab without stealing visual focus.

force.description: Skip the occlusion and animation-stability gates for a knowingly covered or endlessly animating target

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.cursor.scroll
agent_cursor.description: Scroll active or background tab using visual Agent Cursor in live AntiFan Desktop tab.

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.cursor.hover
agent_cursor.description: Move visual Agent Cursor to hover over an element in live AntiFan Desktop tab.

force.description: Skip the occlusion and animation-stability gates for a knowingly covered or endlessly animating target

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.cursor.highlight
agent_cursor.description: Highlight a DOM element with visual Agent Cursor overlay in live AntiFan Desktop tab.

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.cursor.clear
agent_cursor.description: Clear all active Agent Cursor overlays in live AntiFan Desktop tab.

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.file_upload
agent_cursor.description: Upload local files into a file input element in live AntiFan Desktop tab without native file dialogs.

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.drop
agent_cursor.description: Dispatch native drag and drop file transfer onto a target drop zone element in live AntiFan Desktop tab.

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.drag
agent_cursor.description: Drag a control (price slider, range handle, drag-to-reorder row) from one element/coordinate to another with a bounded interpolated pointer gesture. A press-and-release at the destination alone does not move a slider library.

fromRef.description: Origin semantic ref (@e1) from a snapshot

force.description: Skip the occlusion and animation-stability gates for a knowingly covered target

agent_cursor.name: anti.agent.sequence
agent_cursor.description: Execute an atomic multi-step action sequence (navigate, click, type, scroll, hover, pressKey, wait, screenshot, snapshot) in 1 roundtrip with auto-wait and navigation guards.

artifact.name: anti.artifact.read
artifact.description: Read an authorized artifact by ID with bounded chunk size (clamped to max 32KB per frame).

artifact.name: anti.artifact.stat
artifact.description: Retrieve metadata and size information for an authorized artifact.

artifact.name: file.read
artifact.description: Read a file relative to the authoritative workspace root.

artifact.name: file.write
artifact.description: Write a file relative to the authoritative workspace root with boundary enforcement.

other.name: browser_find
other.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text, pattern, query, or a regular expression.

other.name: browser_press_key
other.description: Send native keyboard key press (Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, Arrow keys, etc.) or combination (Control+a) to the active tab

other.name: device.list
other.description: List iOS devices attached to this host (live enumeration over the USB multiplexer). Tier-2 surface: the real phone, not a Chromium pane.

other.name: device.status
other.description: Read physical device readiness gates (attachment, trust, Developer Mode, UI Automation, WebDriverAgent) plus the current device binding. Reports absence honestly instead of failing, so "not set up" is never mistaken for "broken".

deviceId.description: Device UDID; omit when exactly one device is attached

other.name: device.open_safari
other.description: Establish the Safari automation surface on the device (ensure the WebDriverAgent session) and return the bound device target, optionally deep-linking to a url.

deviceId.description: Device UDID; omit when exactly one device is attached

url.description: Optional url to open on the device (deep-link; no load wait)

other.name: device.navigate
other.description: Open a url in Safari on the real device. This is a deep-link: it returns immediately and never waits for load, so follow it with device.wait when a settled page matters.

other.name: device.reload
other.description: Re-open the last url this surface navigated to. WebDriverAgent exposes no refresh route and no URL readback, so reload is refused when no url is remembered.

other.name: device.screenshot
other.description: Capture real-device screenshot evidence (the actual panel pixels a human would see) into the artifact store as a Tier-2 receipt.

other.name: device.tap
other.description: Tap a point on the device panel. Coordinates are CSS points (the device viewport space), not raw pixels.

other.name: device.swipe
other.description: Swipe on the device panel with a native gesture; momentum scrolling is produced by the device and nothing is emulated.

other.name: device.type
other.description: Type text through the native keyboard into the currently focused field (tap the input first; WebDriverAgent types into the active element).

other.name: device.wait
other.description: Wait on the real device: 'timeout' sleeps; 'page_loaded'/'stable' sample frames until rendering stops changing. That is a rendering heuristic, not a load or network-idle guarantee.

other.name: anti.telemetry.record_fallback
other.description: Record sanitized fallback telemetry when invoking Playwright after an AntiFan capability failure.

other.name: anti.trace.interaction
other.description: Trace an interactive action (click, hover, focus, type, scroll) capturing pre/post DOM changes, style deltas, and layout shifts.

other.name: anti.media.freeze
other.description: Freeze or unfreeze dynamic media (videos, audios, CSS animations) in tab to enable deterministic visual comparisons. Native requestAnimationFrame scheduling is left untouched, so RAF-driven motion requires the settle barrier instead.

freeze.description: True to freeze media and pause animations; false to resume

other.name: core.query
other.description: Query the local Super Core evidence store: anchored claims filtered by text/platform/unit/kind. Platform filter excludes untagged claims unless includeGlobal.

other.name: core.context_pack
other.description: Build a Context Pack for a task: relevant claims, unresolved conflicts, unknowns, permission scope. Packs dedupe on (task, platform, sessionId, scope).

scope.description: Project root (absolute path) whose units rank first. A preference, not a filter: cross-project claims still fill the pack.

other.name: core.recommend
other.description: Recommend from evidence: Context Pack + recommendation or explicit abstention.

scope.description: Project root (absolute path) whose units rank first. A preference, not a filter: cross-project claims still fill the pack.

other.name: core.receipt
other.description: Issue a Decision Receipt binding task context and evidence revisions. Refused when Core unavailable.

other.name: core.ingest_outcome
other.description: Ingest a verified outcome as a case + pending candidate (never auto-promoted).

other.name: core.adjudicate
other.description: Adjudicate a candidate (PROMOTE/REJECT/SUPERSEDE) with explicit authority. Refused when Core unavailable.

other.name: core.stats
other.description: Return Super Core store counts for verification.

other.name: core.health
other.description: Aggregated Core Health: status, reasonCode, stats, audit, decay and phase gates. Read-only.

other.name: core.reuse_metric
other.description: Historical reuse for a task: found + injected + outcome-linked counts, each witnessed by rows. Read-only.

other.name: core.domain
other.description: Return a domain view (units, claims, eligible skills, gaps) or insufficient-evidence.

other.name: core.invalidate
other.description: Mark claims stale when their source changed or was deleted.

other.name: core.revoke
other.description: Revoke claims derived from a restricted source (permission propagation).

other.name: core.snapshot
other.description: Create a release snapshot for regression/rollback.

other.name: core.rollback
other.description: Restore claims/candidates to a release snapshot.

other.name: core.record_experience_node
other.description: Record an experience graph node (CLIENT_REQUEST, PROJECT, TASK, CONTEXT, DECISION, IMPLEMENTATION, ARTIFACT, VERIFICATION, PRODUCTION, FEEDBACK, LESSON).

other.name: core.record_experience_edge
other.description: Record an experience graph edge between two nodes.

other.name: core.experience_chain
other.description: Traverse the experience graph from a node (BFS, depth-bounded).

other.name: core.record_anti_pattern
other.description: Record an anti-pattern: what not to do, symptoms, evidence, affected platform, replacement.

other.name: core.anti_patterns
other.description: List anti-patterns, optionally filtered by platform/status.

other.name: core.record_workaround
other.description: Record a workaround: problem, condition, solution, reason, platform, version, evidence.

other.name: core.workarounds
other.description: List workarounds, optionally filtered by platform/stillValid.

other.name: core.record_fix_pattern
other.description: Record a fix pattern: before, after, why, evidence, lesson.

other.name: core.fix_patterns
other.description: List fix patterns.

other.name: core.find_similar
other.description: Find similar claims, cases, decisions, anti-patterns, workarounds, fix patterns for a task. Platform filter excludes untagged rows unless includeGlobal.

other.name: core.classify_uncertainty
other.description: Classify uncertainty level for a claim or task.

other.name: core.decay_check
other.description: Check for stale/aging claims beyond a threshold.

other.name: core.corpus_audit
other.description: Run a corpus completion audit (read-only evaluation).

other.name: core.candidates
other.description: List adjudication candidates (default PENDING).

other.name: core.knowledge_gaps
other.description: Classify per-platform knowledge gaps: NO_EVIDENCE (never had claims), STALE (claims exist, none fresh), CONFLICTED (claims + unresolved conflicts), NONE.

other.name: core.check_phase_gate
other.description: Check a phase gate (coverage, evidence, conflict, temporal, promotion, regression).

other.name: core.resolve_conflict
other.description: Resolve or classify a conflict (GENERAL_RULE, CONTEXTUAL_RULE, LEGACY_RULE, EXCEPTION, CONFLICTED, UNRESOLVED).

other.name: core.record_regression
other.description: Record a core regression definition; core.replay_regression re-executes its checks against live state and writes the result.

other.name: core.replay_regression
other.description: Re-execute a recorded regression's checks against live state and write replayResult + replayedAt.

other.name: core.record_observation
other.description: Record a raw observation (source, kind, payload) into the learning loop.

other.name: core.record_principle
other.description: Record a personal engineering principle.

other.name: core.principles
other.description: List principles.

other.name: core.record_hidden_requirement
other.description: Record a hidden requirement inferred from a task.

other.name: core.hidden_requirements
other.description: List hidden requirements.

other.name: core.record_commercial
other.description: Record commercial intelligence for a task type.

other.name: core.commercial_intel
other.description: List commercial intelligence records.

other.name: core.record_tool
other.description: Record tool intelligence.

other.name: core.tool_intel
other.description: List tool intelligence records.

other.name: core.record_archetype
other.description: Record a project archetype.

other.name: core.archetypes
other.description: List archetypes.

other.name: core.record_platform_semantic
other.description: Record a platform semantic fact.

other.name: core.platform_semantics
other.description: List platform semantics.

other.name: core.record_practice_parity
other.description: Record declared vs observed practice parity.

other.name: core.practice_parity
other.description: List practice parity records.

other.name: core.record_skill_version
other.description: Record a skill version/failure/fix/production event.

other.name: core.skill_genealogy
other.description: List skill version history.

other.name: core.context_pack_v2
other.description: Build an enriched Context Pack: claims + rules + historical cases + pitfalls + workarounds + recommended pattern + uncertainty + confidence.

scope.description: Project root (absolute path) whose units rank first. A preference, not a filter: cross-project claims still fill the pack.

other.name: core.receipt_v2
other.description: Issue an enriched Decision Receipt: evidence revisions + why + historical cases + risks + alternatives + uncertainty + confidence.

other.name: terminal.write
other.description: Write raw input text to an active PTY terminal session. Writing to a SLEEPING session wakes it (a fresh shell in the same cwd) and then delivers the input; the result reports woke=true

input.description: Data/commands to write into PTY stdin

other.name: terminal.resize
other.description: Resize terminal rows and columns for an active PTY session

other.name: terminal.wait
other.description: Wait for output-match pattern, process exit, or silence on a terminal session. A SLEEPING session returns immediately with satisfied=false, sleeping=true and code=SESSION_SLEEPING instead of blocking: it is never woken here, write input to wake it

other.name: terminal.list
other.description: List active terminal sessions with bounded wire summary and incarnation metadata

paged.description: Whether to page buffers according to wire budget

other.name: terminal.create
other.description: Create a new base or split terminal PTY session

other.name: terminal.close
other.description: Close a terminal session and safely terminate its process tree

isSplit.description: Whether target is a split session
